newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Toyota yr shr falls, div up.
newsitem.headline: Toyota yr shr falls, div up.

text.p: Full name: Toyota South Africa Ltd (motor)
NOTE - The company said that some comparative figures for 1995 had been restated because the results of the offshore Tory Investment Group had been consolidated for the first time in 1996.
The investment in the Tory Group had been made during the sanctions-era. More details would be made available later, it said.
The company said it expected the new vehicle retail market to continue growing modestly in 1997.

Profit margins of motor vehicle manufacturers would be under pressure for various reasons including severe competition, increased demand for entry level vehicles coupled with affordability problems, increased costs and the weakening of the rand against foreign currencies.
More detailed commentary on prospects would be contained its the annual report.
